name: Ampleness and Lawrence Total Asymmetry
statement: A finite sign family is ample, equivalently lopsided, exactly when every antipodally invariant face section is empty or the full face.
proof: If a face section is antipodally invariant but neither empty nor full, its support is shattered without being strongly shattered, contradicting ampleness. Conversely, a shattered support lacking its full cube has a minimal missing face pattern; restricting to that minimal face produces a nonempty proper antipodally invariant section, contradicting total asymmetry.
